items.title: Quick start
items.text: One tap for a sauna, a cold plunge, or both. Big numbers and big buttons for wet hands.

items.title: Protocols
items.text: Follow rounds of sauna, cold plunge and rest, or build your own. Each phase waits for you to move on.

items.title: Time's up alerts
items.text: A sound and haptic when a phase ends, a notification when your phone is locked, and the timer on your Lock Screen.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Save finished sessions to Apple Health as workouts, if you like. Contrast never reads your health data.

items.title: Session history
items.text: Every session with its phases and notes, plus sessions this week, days in a row, and time in heat and cold.

items.title: Safety first
items.text: Plain safety tips built in: drink water, never plunge alone, and check with your doctor first. Contrast is a timer, not medical advice.

items.title: Completely offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your data stays on your iPhone.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Contrast doesn't even make network requests. Your session data lives on your device and nowhere else.

cta.title: Start your session.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
